macros.name: leftpagecontent
macros.doc: Define a macro that stores the contents that shall be output on a left-hand page.

macros.name: leftpagecontrolend
macros.doc: Define a macro that may contain control statements that are executed at the end of left-hand pages after \leftpagecontent.

macros.name: leftpagecontrolstart
macros.doc: Define a macro that may contain control statements that are executed at the beginning of left-hand pages before \leftpagecontent.

macros.name: rightpagecontrolstart
macros.doc: Define a macro that may contain control statements that are executed at the beginning of right-hand pages before the running text continues.

macros.name: semionesideoff
macros.doc: Define a macro to deactivate semi one sided layout.
